```sql
WITH dubberly_geom AS (
  SELECT geometry::geometry AS geom
  FROM regions
  WHERE region_name ILIKE 'Dubberly'
    AND addr_state ILIKE 'Louisiana'
)
SELECT MAX((ST_Value(r.rast, d.geom)).val) AS max_elevation
FROM dubberly_geom d
JOIN public.dem_us r
  ON ST_Intersects(r.rast, d.geom);
```
